electricity-grid.webp.author: Novoklimov

water-cooling.webp.title: Crossflow diagram.svg
water-cooling.webp.author: Eric Dreher / Zerodamage
water-cooling.webp.changes: 1280-pixel Wikimedia raster preview converted to WebP over a white background. No crop or content changes.
water-cooling.webp.alt: Diagram menara pendingin: air panas masuk, udara kering masuk dari samping, udara hangat dan lembap keluar, serta air dingin terkumpul di bawah.
water-cooling.webp.altEn: Cooling-tower diagram: hot water enters, dry air enters from the sides, warm moist air leaves, and cooled water collects below.
water-cooling.webp.caption: Menara pendingin membuang panas melalui aliran udara dan penguapan sebagian air.
water-cooling.webp.captionEn: A cooling tower releases heat through airflow and the evaporation of some water.
water-cooling.webp.context: Diagram of a generic induced-draft crossflow cooling tower. Shows the evaporation pathway relevant to water consumption without implying every data center uses this design.

data-center-power.webp.title: EPS 6000 Row A.jpg
data-center-power.webp.author: Robert.Harker
data-center-power.webp.altEn: A row of UPS cabinets supporting a data center's electrical supply.
data-center-power.webp.captionEn: UPS cabinets help maintain electrical supply. Data center infrastructure includes supporting equipment alongside servers.
data-center-power.webp.context: UPS cabinet row A, photographed 1 October 2012. Concrete example of facility electrical infrastructure, not the data centers measured by the cited IEA report and not evidence of their energy use.
data-center-power.webp.changes: Downloaded the Wikimedia 1280-pixel thumbnail and encoded as WebP; no crop or retouch. Delivered image remains under CC BY-SA 3.0.
data-center-power.webp.alt: Deretan kabinet UPS yang mendukung pasokan listrik pusat data.
data-center-power.webp.caption: Kabinet UPS membantu menjaga pasokan listrik. Infrastruktur pusat data mencakup peralatan pendukung selain server.

training-inference.webp.title: Conceptual illustration of the process of training and inference — Figure 1
training-inference.webp.author: Donghee Ha, Mooseop Kim, KyeongDeok Moon, and Chi Yoon Jeong
training-inference.webp.altEn: Diagram of training with forward propagation, backpropagation and weight updates, followed by a trained model running inference on new data.
training-inference.webp.captionEn: On the left, training updates model weights through repeated steps. On the right, inference uses the trained model to predict from new data.
training-inference.webp.context: Figure 1 of Accelerating On-Device Learning with Layer-Wise Processor Selection Method on Unified Memory, Sensors 2021, 21(7), 2364, DOI 10.3390/s21072364. Used solely as a conceptual training/inference illustration; it supplies no AI footprint measurements. English labels retained; localized caption and alt explain the key distinction. Display without cropping.
training-inference.webp.changes: Proportionally resized the publisher's Figure 1 to 1600 x 947 and encoded as WebP; labels, arrows and layout retained, no crop or retouch.
training-inference.webp.alt: Diagram pelatihan dengan propagasi maju, propagasi balik, dan pembaruan bobot, diikuti model terlatih yang menjalankan inferensi pada data baru.
training-inference.webp.caption: Di kiri, pelatihan memperbarui bobot model melalui beberapa langkah berulang. Di kanan, inferensi memakai model terlatih untuk menghasilkan prediksi dari data baru.

water-location.webp.alt: Seseorang berjalan melewati dasar Danau Sentarum yang retak pada musim kemarau, Kalimantan Barat.
water-location.webp.altEn: A person walks across the cracked bed of Lake Sentarum during the dry season in West Kalimantan.
water-location.webp.caption: Danau Sentarum, Kalimantan Barat, pada musim kemarau Agustus 2019. Kondisi air berubah menurut tempat dan musim; foto ini tidak menunjukkan dampak AI.
water-location.webp.captionEn: Lake Sentarum, West Kalimantan, in the August 2019 dry season. Water conditions vary by place and season; this photograph does not show an AI impact.
water-location.webp.context: Local seasonal water context, photographed 5 August 2019. No attribution of the dry lakebed to AI or data centers.
